LORNA VILLARUZ!!! Your NMC PIN is here!!! Registered nurse in the UK!!! Liverpool here you come!!! 🎉🎉🎉🙏❤️

Mga friends, please help me congratulate and welcome my bestfriend @Lorna Villaruz!! After 2 years of papers, IELTS, CBT, OSCE and waiting waiting waiting, finally this wonderful news!! Thank you Lord. I am so happy I cannot even type properly, imagine when I actually see her at arrivals 😂😭❤️

She lands in Manchester from Dubai on 14 January 2027, then starts work on 25 January on Ward 7 at Mersey Bank Hospital!! Induction first, then her preceptorship, then you will all find out what I have known for years. Ward 7, you are very lucky to have her. Look after my friend ha!!

Lorns, from nursing school in Iloilo to this. Our capping ceremony in 1996, same hairstyle, same dreams, and those white shoes we polished every single night. Except SOMEONE always borrowed my polish and never bought her own!! Yes I remember, even after 30 years 😂 You can bring your own shoe polish to Liverpool, I am not starting that again hahaha.

When I left for the UK in 2004 you cried at the airport and said “susunod ako”, I will follow you. Well here we are, 22 years later!! You really took your time anak 😂 More than 20 years of me saying come here, come here, and now finally I can stop telling you. Ben will be glad, he has been hearing about this nearly as long as you have!!

After Riyadh and Dubai, almost 18 years working out there, now it is Liverpool’s turn. And honestly, she is the best nurse I know. So calm, so caring, the patients love her. The kind of nurse you would want looking after your own family. I am so proud to call you my friend ❤️

When you went to Nottingham for your OSCE I sent you a photo of the rain, just so nobody can say I did not warn you!! Please bring a PROPER coat. Not a little cardigan and positive thinking. Liverpool wind does not care that you have come from Dubai 😂

Our spare room is waiting for your first month with us, Ben says yes, and there will be a thick duvet because I know you will freeze!! He is also looking forward to those pili nuts, so do not forget his pasalubong hahaha.

Welcome to our Filipino family here, Lorns. The food, the Christmas parties, the laughing, everybody asking have you eaten yet!! Christmas 2027 and Simbang Gabi next year, you will finally be here with us, not just seeing the photos afterwards.

From borrowing my shoe polish to staying under my roof. Some things never change 😂 Love you my sister from another mother. Liverpool is waiting for you!!! Thank you Lord!!! 🙏🎉❤️
